page.overview:
Who is Admiral Carstairs?

Admiral Carstairs is a former member of the United States military. He is a friend of Charles Montgomery Burns. Burns introduced him to his son Larry Burns, who offended him with a joke about Carstairs' age. Who believed he was over 200.

He can also briefly be seen getting killed by Jonathan Frink Sr. in Treehouse of Horror XIV.
